modes.definition_zh: 人的发展必须是肌肉与智识的永久统一。顾拜旦批判现代教育将身体训练与智力发展割裂，导致'行走的词典'式的畸形培养。他复兴古希腊的kalokagathia（美善合一）理想，主张体育教育应同时培养身体的力量与精神的卓越。身心合一不是简单的并列，而是有机的统一：身体是精神的载体，精神是身体的升华，二者相互促进、不可分割。
modes.definition_en: Human development must be the permanent union of muscles and intellect. Coubertin criticized modern education for splitting physical training from intellectual development, producing 'walking dictionaries.' He revived the ancient Greek ideal of kalokagathia (beauty and goodness in unity), arguing that physical education must cultivate both bodily strength and spiritual excellence. Mind-body unity is not mere parallelism but organic integration: the body is the vessel of spirit, spirit is the elevation of the body — they mutually enhance and cannot be separated.
modes.source_chapter: 《奥林匹克回忆录》（Mémoires olympiques，1931）；《体育教育学》（Pédagogie sportive，1922）
modes.key_quote_zh: 问题的关键在于恢复肌肉与智识的永久统一，而这种统一在当今已被割裂。我相信这种统一曾经行之有效，但在不利的影响下二者逐渐分离，最终走向完全冷漠——分离变成了相互遗忘。奥林匹亚曾是它们的主要居所，现在已被重建、再生和翻新。
modes.key_quote_en: The pith of the matter is to reestablish the permanent union of muscles and intellect, which we now find dissolved. I am sure that the union was once productive, but as soon as they grew apart under the influence of adverse conditions, they gradually came to a total mutual indifference. Olympia, which was their main residence in the past, is now reconstructed, regenerated and renovated.
process_zh: 识别身心分裂的教育现状与危害
追溯古希腊kalokagathia的完整人格理想
确立体育与智育的并重地位与互促关系
在实践中实现身心有机统一的培养
process_en: Identify the split between physical and intellectual education and its harms
Trace the ancient Greek ideal of kalokagathia — the complete human personality
Establish equal status and mutual reinforcement of physical and intellectual training
Achieve organic mind-body unity through practice
representative_cases_zh: 顾拜旦批判法国教育培养'行走的词典'，主张恢复体育在教育体系中的核心地位
他将古代奥运会本身就包含的艺术竞赛纳入现代奥运，体现身心合一的完整教育观
反例警示：若只重视智力而忽视体育，会产生身体孱弱、意志薄弱的畸形人格
representative_cases_en: Coubertin criticized French education for producing 'walking dictionaries,' advocating the restoration of physical education as a core subject
He incorporated ancient Olympic art competitions into the modern Games, reflecting a complete educational vision of mind-body unity
Counterexample: valuing only intellect while neglecting sport produces physically weak and willfully fragile personalities

modes.definition_zh: 参与本身比胜利更重要。顾拜旦借美国主教之口提出奥林匹克信条：'奥林匹克比赛中最重要的不是取胜，而是参与；正如生活中最重要的不是征服，而是奋力拼搏。'这一方法将竞赛的价值从结果导向转向过程导向，强调奋斗过程的人格塑造意义。
modes.definition_en: Participation itself is more important than victory. Coubertin, borrowing from an American bishop, formulated the Olympic Creed: 'The most important thing in the Olympic Games is not winning but taking part; the most important thing in life is not triumph but the struggle.' This method shifts the value of competition from outcome-oriented to process-oriented.
modes.source_chapter: 《奥林匹克回忆录》（Mémoires olympiques，1931）；1908年伦敦奥运会演讲
modes.key_quote_zh: 奥林匹克比赛中最重要的不是取胜，而是参与；正如生活中最重要的不是征服，而是奋力拼搏。本质不在于凯旋，而在于奋力拼搏。
modes.key_quote_en: The most important thing in the Olympic Games is not winning but taking part; the most important thing in life is not triumph but the struggle. The essential thing is not to have conquered but to have fought well.
process_zh: 重新定义成功的标准：从'胜利'转向'参与'
将关注焦点从结果转移至过程
确认参与本身的教育价值和人格塑造意义
以奋斗精神取代胜负二元论的价值判断
process_en: Redefine success: shift from 'victory' to 'participation'
Redirect focus from outcome to process
Affirm the educational value and character-building significance of participation itself
Replace the win-lose binary with a struggle-oriented value judgment
representative_cases_zh: 1908年伦敦奥运会马拉松比赛中，意大利选手多兰多·彼得里体力透支闯入终点，虽被取消成绩，但其坚持到底的精神赢得全场起立鼓掌
顾拜旦反复强调，奥林匹克运动的价值不在于创造世界纪录，而在于激发每个人的参与热情
反例警示：若将'参与至上'理解为降低标准，就会滑向平庸主义
representative_cases_en: At the 1908 London Olympics Marathon, Italian runner Dorando Pietri, exhausted, stumbled across the finish line. Though disqualified, his determination earned a standing ovation
Coubertin repeatedly stressed that the value of the Olympic Movement lies not in world records but in inspiring universal participation
Counterexample: interpreting 'participation supremacy' as lowering standards slides into mediocrity

modes.definition_zh: 通过复兴古代奥运会传统来应对现代社会的危机。顾拜旦不是简单复制古代形式，而是创造性地转化古代资源，使其适应现代需求。
modes.definition_en: Reviving the ancient Olympic tradition to address modern social crises. Coubertin did not merely copy ancient forms but creatively transformed ancient resources to meet modern needs.
modes.key_quote_zh: 复兴古代奥林匹克运动会，不是为了复古，而是为了借助古代的理想来应对现代的挑战。
modes.key_quote_en: The revival of the ancient Olympic Games was not an exercise in nostalgia, but a creative transformation of ancient resources to meet modern challenges.
process_zh: 诊断当代社会面临的核心危机
追溯古代文化资源中的相关智慧
选择性提取可转化的核心元素
创造性重构以适应现代语境
process_en: Diagnose the core crises facing contemporary society
Trace relevant wisdom in ancient cultural resources
Selectively extract transformable core elements
Creatively reconstruct to fit modern context
representative_cases_zh: 顾拜旦从古希腊奥运会的'神圣休战'传统中提取和平理念，转化为现代奥林匹克休战决议
他参考古代奥运设计现代奥林匹克五环图案，赋予其新的象征意义
反例警示：若将古代复兴简单理解为形式上的复制，就会陷入文化保守主义
representative_cases_en: Coubertin extracted the peace concept from the ancient Olympic 'Ekecheiria' tradition and transformed it into the modern Olympic Truce Resolution
He designed the modern Olympic rings symbol, endowing it with new meaning
Counterexample: treating ancient revival as mere formal copying falls into cultural conservatism
modern_applications_zh: 传统资源的创新性使用
文化复兴与现代化平衡

modes.definition_zh: 体育是促进国际理解与和平的有效途径。顾拜旦相信，通过国际体育竞赛，各国青年可以在公平竞争中建立相互尊重和友谊。
modes.definition_en: Sport is an effective means to promote international understanding and peace. Coubertin believed that through international sporting competitions, young people from different nations could build mutual respect and friendship in fair competition.
modes.source_chapter: 《奥林匹克回忆录》（Mémoires olympiques，1931）；1894年索邦大学演讲
modes.key_quote_zh: 体育能够把不同国家、不同文化背景的年轻人聚集在一起，在公平的规则下竞争，在尊重的氛围中交流。
modes.key_quote_en: Sport can bring together young people from different countries and cultural backgrounds to compete fairly and exchange ideas respectfully.
process_zh: 识别国际紧张局势与冲突根源
设计体育交流的跨国机制
创造非政治化的接触空间
培育跨国界的友谊与理解
process_en: Identify international tensions and the roots of conflict
Design cross-border mechanisms for sporting exchange
Create non-political spaces for contact
Foster transnational friendship and understanding
representative_cases_zh: 1936年柏林奥运会，尽管纳粹试图利用奥运会进行种族宣传，但不同国家运动员之间的交流仍在一定程度上实现
冷战期间，美苏等国的体育交流成为外交破冰的尝试
反例警示：若体育被纯粹政治化利用，就会背离奥林匹克和平使命
representative_cases_en: At the 1936 Berlin Olympics, despite Nazi attempts, cross-border athlete exchange was partially realized
During the Cold War, sporting exchanges between the US and USSR served as diplomatic breakthrough efforts
Counterexample: when sport is purely politicized, it背离s the Olympic peace mission

modes.definition_zh: 坚持业余主义原则，确保体育竞赛的纯洁性和公平性。顾拜旦认为，职业化会腐蚀体育精神，只有业余运动员才能在无经济利益驱动的情况下体现纯粹的竞技道德。
modes.definition_en: Maintaining the amateur principle to ensure the purity and fairness of sporting competition. Coubertin believed professionalization would corrupt the spirit of sport; only amateur athletes could demonstrate pure competitive ethics without economic incentives.
modes.key_quote_zh: 业余主义是奥林匹克运动的基石。它确保了竞赛的纯洁性，防止了金钱对体育精神的侵蚀。
modes.key_quote_en: Amateurism is the cornerstone of the Olympic Movement. It ensures the purity of competition and prevents the corrosion of money on the spirit of sport.
process_zh: 界定业余与职业的明确界限
排除经济利益对竞赛的干扰
确立公平竞争的环境与条件
维护体育的精神价值与道德高度
process_en: Define clear boundaries between amateur and professional
Exclude economic interests from interfering with competition
Establish fair competitive environment and conditions
Preserve sport's spiritual values and moral heights
representative_cases_zh: 顾拜旦坚决抵制职业运动员参加奥运会
直到1980年代，国际奥委会才逐步放宽业余主义限制
反例警示：若将业余主义绝对化，就会排除广大劳动者参与奥运的机会
representative_cases_en: Coubertin firmly opposed professional athletes participating in the Olympics
It was not until the 1980s that the IOC gradually relaxed amateur restrictions
Counterexample: absolute amateurism excludes working-class athletes from Olympic participation

modes.name_en: Character Forging Method (Moral Education through Sport)
modes.definition_zh: 体育是锻造品格的最佳工具。顾拜旦相信，竞技运动中的挑战、挫折、团队合作和公平竞争能够培养坚韧、勇气、诚实和自律等美德。
modes.definition_en: Sport is the best tool for forging character. Coubertin believed that the challenges, setbacks, teamwork, and fair play inherent in competitive sports cultivate virtues such as resilience, courage, honesty, and self-discipline.
modes.source_chapter: 《公共教育笔记》（Notes sur l'éducation publique，1901）
modes.key_quote_zh: 体育能够强有力地锤炼性格，培养所谓的'道德肌肉'。
modes.key_quote_en: Sport powerfully tempers character, cultivating what may be called 'moral muscles.'
process_zh: 选择适合的体育项目和竞赛形式
设置适度的挑战和困难
在实践中体验挫折与成功的双重历练
提炼品格要素并通过反思内化
process_en: Select appropriate sports and competitive formats
Set moderate challenges and difficulties
Experience both setbacks and success through practice
Extract character elements and internalize through reflection
representative_cases_zh: 顾拜旦认为，体育竞赛中的失败比胜利更具教育价值
他特别强调团队合作运动对培养集体主义精神的独特作用
反例警示：若将品格锻造简化为'输不起'的胜负心态，就会培养出脆弱的竞争者
representative_cases_en: Coubertin believed that failure in sport carries greater educational value than victory
He particularly emphasized team sports for their unique role in cultivating collectivism
Counterexample: reducing character forging to a 'cannot lose' mentality produces fragile competitors
modern_applications_zh: 逆境训练与心理韧性建设
modern_applications_en: Adversity training and psychological resilience building

modes.definition_zh: 通过仪式和象征物的设计来强化集体认同和精神感召。顾拜旦设计了奥林匹克五环标志、奥林匹克旗帜、奥运圣火传递等象征体系。
modes.definition_en: Strengthening collective identity and spiritual inspiration through the design of rituals and symbols. Coubertin designed the Olympic rings logo, the Olympic flag, the Olympic cauldron tradition, and other symbolic systems.
modes.key_quote_zh: 一个运动如果没有仪式和象征，就缺乏灵魂。
modes.key_quote_en: A movement without rituals and symbols lacks soul.
process_zh: 提炼核心价值和精神理念
设计具象化的象征符号
建立重复性的仪式程式
强化集体记忆和情感认同
process_en: Extract core values and spiritual concepts
Design concrete symbolic representations
Establish recurring ceremonial formats
Strengthen collective memory and emotional identification
representative_cases_zh: 顾拜旦设计的五环标志：五个相交的圆环代表五大洲，六种颜色涵盖所有国旗的颜色
他确立了圣火传递仪式，从希腊奥林匹亚采集圣火，通过火炬接力传递到主办城市
反例警示：若仪式流于形式主义，就会沦为空洞的表演
representative_cases_en: Coubertin's five-ring design: five interlocking rings represent the five continents, and six colors encompass all national flag colors
He established the cauldron relay tradition, collecting flame from Olympia in Greece
Counterexample: when rituals degenerate into empty formalism, they become hollow performances

modes.definition_zh: 通过建立持久性的国际组织来保障理想的实现。顾拜旦创建了国际奥委会（IOC）这一常设机构，设计了其治理结构、决策程序和发展战略。
modes.definition_en: Ensuring the realization of ideals through establishing durable international institutions. Coubertin created the International Olympic Committee (IOC) as a standing institution, designing its governance structure, decision-making procedures, and development strategy.
modes.source_chapter: 《奥林匹克回忆录》（Mémoires olympiques，1931）；1894年索邦大学演讲
modes.key_quote_zh: 理念需要载体，理想需要机构。
modes.key_quote_en: Ideas need vessels; ideals need institutions.
process_zh: 明确组织的使命和价值观
设计合理的治理结构和权力分配
建立透明的决策机制和监督程序
确保组织的持续运作和适应性变革
process_en: Clarify the organization's mission and values
Design reasonable governance structure and power distribution
Establish transparent decision-making mechanisms and oversight procedures
Ensure continuous operation and adaptive transformation
representative_cases_zh: 1894年索邦大学国际会议上，顾拜旦推动成立了国际奥林匹克委员会
他确立了国际奥委会作为'非政府、非营利、永久性'国际组织的定位
反例警示：若机构设置过于集权，就会丧失民主性和适应性
representative_cases_en: At the 1894 Sorbonne International Congress, Coubertin pushed for the establishment of the International Olympic Committee
He positioned the IOC as a 'non-governmental, non-profit, permanent' international organization
Counterexample: overly centralized institutional design loses democracy and adaptability

modes.definition_zh: 体育与艺术应当融合，共同服务于人的全面发展。顾拜旦认为古希腊的奥运会本身就包含艺术竞赛，现代奥运会也应恢复这一传统。
modes.definition_en: Sport and art should integrate, serving together the comprehensive development of human beings. Coubertin believed the ancient Olympics already included art competitions, and the modern Games should restore this tradition.
modes.key_quote_zh: 没有艺术的体育是盲目的，没有体育的艺术是空洞的。
modes.key_quote_en: Sport without art is blind; art without sport is empty.
process_zh: 追溯古代体育与艺术融合的传统
设计艺术竞赛的机制和类别
建立体育与艺术的对话空间
实现完整的人格教育和创造力培养
process_en: Trace the ancient tradition of sport-art integration
Design mechanisms and categories for art competitions
Create dialogic spaces between sport and art
Achieve complete personality education and creativity cultivation
representative_cases_zh: 1912年斯德哥尔摩奥运会首次正式设立艺术竞赛
他主张现代奥运村应兼具体育功能与美学价值
反例警示：若艺术竞赛沦为体育的附庸或装饰，就会失去其独立价值
representative_cases_en: At the 1912 Stockholm Olympics, art competitions were formally established for the first time
He argued that modern Olympic villages should combine sporting functionality with aesthetic value
Counterexample: when art competitions become mere appendages or decorations to sport, they lose their independent value

modes.definition_zh: 通过规则和仪式将暴力冲突转化为和平竞争。顾拜旦继承了古代奥运会的'神圣休战'（Ekecheiria）传统，主张体育竞赛可以成为替代战争的'文明战场'。
modes.definition_en: Transforming violent conflict into peaceful competition through rules and rituals. Coubertin inherited the ancient Olympic 'Ekecheiria' (sacred truce) tradition, arguing that sporting competition could serve as a 'civilized battlefield' alternative to war.
modes.key_quote_zh: 战争是人类最古老的竞争形式，但它带来了毁灭而非进步。奥林匹克运动会提供了一种更高级的竞争方式。
modes.key_quote_en: War is humanity's most ancient form of competition, but it brings destruction rather than progress. The Olympic Games offer a higher form of competition.
process_zh: 承认竞争是人类社会的必然现象
设计公平规则的竞技框架
将对抗纳入仪式化的和平轨道
以和平方式实现卓越追求
process_en: Acknowledge competition as an inevitable feature of human society
Design fair-ruled competitive frameworks
Channel confrontation into ritualized peaceful tracks
Pursue excellence through peaceful means
representative_cases_zh: 顾拜旦复兴古代奥运会的'神圣休战'传统，呼吁各国在奥运期间停止军事冲突
他设计了严格的竞赛规则和裁判制度，确保所有参与者在同一规则下公平竞争
反例警示：若竞争规则被强者任意修改，就会沦为弱肉强食的合法化伪装
representative_cases_en: Coubertin revived the ancient Olympic 'Ekecheiria' tradition, calling on nations to cease military conflict during the Games
He designed strict competition rules and referee systems, ensuring all participants compete fairly under the same rules
Counterexample: when competitive rules are arbitrarily modified by the strong, they become a legitimizing disguise for might-makes-right
